items.html: Also by this you will understand the matter of the eunuch, who has no splendor of face and beard, for behold, this Yesod of AA, in its arousal, caused the arousal of the two Mazalot of the upper beard, as mentioned. And remember this discourse of MAN — of the souls of the righteous and of ZON — what their benefit is, and how everything is connected, and the lower arouses the upper, and the upper returns to bestow to the lower, degree after degree. And also this discourse is the root of all the discourses said concerning the matter of MAN; and guard it and understand it well. But the essence of what MAN are was explained in the Idra of Naso, page 135, column 2.
